title: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Evil Dave
page: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Evil Dave/Quick guide

overview.startPoint: Inspect Evil Dave in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.

questReqs.text: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Wily cat, cat, kitten, or lazy cat
items.text: Wily cat, cat, kitten, or lazy cat
alternatives: Overgrown cats won't work as they do not hunt rats
A kitten is not recommended as the chance of them catching a rat is a low 15% compared to 50% for a normal cat, and will take longer to complete

items.html: Up to 10 bowls of stew (If you make no mistakes, you will not need more than 10 bowls. The Forester's Arms sells stew for 20 coins).
items.text: Up to 10 bowls of stew (If you make no mistakes, you will not need more than 10 bowls. The Forester's Arms sells stew for 20 coins).

items.html: Charged amulet of glory or the Wilderness sword for quick teleport to Edgeville. Alternatively, Edgeville lodestone can be used.
items.text: Charged amulet of glory or the Wilderness sword for quick teleport to Edgeville. Alternatively, Edgeville lodestone can be used.

blocks.html: Inspect Evil Dave inside Lumbridge Castle Banquet Hall.
blocks.text: Inspect Evil Dave inside Lumbridge Castle Banquet Hall.

blocks.html: Optional: West of Edgeville's bank, talk to Doris.
blocks.text: Optional: West of Edgeville's bank, talk to Doris.

blocks.html: Head into the house's basement.
Talk to Evil Dave.

options.text: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

blocks.html: Speak to Doris, upstairs in the house. If you miss this step, the hellrats will only drop ashes.
blocks.text: Speak to Doris, upstairs in the house. If you miss this step, the hellrats will only drop ashes.

blocks.html: Head back in the basement, interact with your cat and select "Chase-Vermin". (Switch off 'Hide Familiar Options' in Gameplay->Combat & Action Bar-> 'Choose Option' Menu)
blocks.text: Head back in the basement, interact with your cat and select "Chase-Vermin". (Switch off 'Hide Familiar Options' in Gameplay->Combat & Action Bar-> 'Choose Option' Menu)

blocks.html: As your cat catches the rats, pick up the spices that drop.
blocks.text: As your cat catches the rats, pick up the spices that drop.

blocks.html: Do so until at least six doses of each of the four spices are collected.
blocks.text: Do so until at least six doses of each of the four spices are collected.

blocks.html: Make Dave's Evil stew by combining doses of each spice on the stews.
blocks.text: Make Dave's Evil stew by combining doses of each spice on the stews.

blocks.html: For each of the spice collected, test each of them individually, a max of 9 stews is needed if done correctly.
Start with 1 dose of any spice on the stew, then use the spicy stew on Evil Dave (right click and use).
blocks.text: Start with 1 dose of any spice on the stew, then use the spicy stew on Evil Dave (right click and use).

blocks.html: If he says one spice is right, note the number of dose using Spice type below.
blocks.text: If he says one spice is right, note the number of dose using Spice type below.

blocks.html: (Skip if 1 dose is correct) Use 2 dose of spice on the stew, then use on Evil Dave, repeat step 2. Do not try for three spices, if 2 doses is wrong then it is 3 doses.
blocks.text: (Skip if 1 dose is correct) Use 2 dose of spice on the stew, then use on Evil Dave, repeat step 2. Do not try for three spices, if 2 doses is wrong then it is 3 doses.

blocks.html: Repeat for each spice.
Once all 4 types of spice dosage are confirmed, use it on another stew with corresponding doses, then use on Evil Dave one last time.
blocks.text: Once all 4 types of spice dosage are confirmed, use it on another stew with corresponding doses, then use on Evil Dave one last time.

blocks.html: This method is sort of like a game of Mastermind.

Spice type
Brown spice
Orange spice
Red spice
Yellow spice
1 brown
1 orange
1 red
1 yellow
2 brown
2 orange
2 red
2 yellow
3 brown
3 orange
3 red
3 yellow
After determining the right combination, have Evil Dave taste it and finish the dialogue. This won't consume the stew.
blocks.text: After determining the right combination, have Evil Dave taste it and finish the dialogue. This won't consume the stew.

blocks.html: Head to Lumbridge and give Evil Dave the stew.
blocks.text: Head to Lumbridge and give Evil Dave the stew.

blocks.html: Subquest complete!
